description: Non-RF two-layer retrieval cases and separate manual AI expectations. Queries are explicit caller choices, not automatically generated from prompts. No AI reasoning is measured by the retrieval script.

cases.prompt: Plan a two-layer sensor PCB.
cases.ai_expectation: Establish edge rates, density and device requirements; propose layer roles without guaranteeing two layers are sufficient.

cases.prompt: Which layer should carry signals on my 2-layer board?
cases.ai_expectation: Explain the top-routing/bottom-ground preference and allow caller-chosen exceptions after return-path review.

cases.prompt: Should my PCB be 0.8 mm or 1.6 mm thick?
cases.ai_expectation: Obtain connector, support, assembly and fabrication constraints; do not promise an EMI or cost outcome.

cases.prompt: Will 0.8 mm cost the same?
cases.ai_expectation: Check the current quote and mechanical fit; the corpus does not provide live pricing.

cases.prompt: Can I set 6 mil clearance and 0.3 mm drill everywhere?
cases.ai_expectation: Check selected copper weight, fabricator and via diameter; distinguish provisional dimensions from manufacturing and safety requirements.

cases.prompt: Set an economical fabrication profile.
cases.ai_expectation: Obtain current manufacturing constraints and explicitly set/read back the selected board rules.

cases.prompt: Is ENIG a free alternative to HASL?
cases.ai_expectation: Explain finish tradeoffs and obtain the current quote without claiming ENIG is free.

cases.prompt: Choose power trace width.
cases.ai_expectation: Ask for current, copper, length, voltage-drop and thermal limits before calculating dimensions.

cases.prompt: A wide power trace necks down at the capacitor. Is that OK?
cases.ai_expectation: Review the constriction and vias with the actual current and thermal assumptions; no unconditional pass.

cases.prompt: My bottom-layer jumper is 1.5 mm long so it passes, right?
cases.ai_expectation: Reject length-only acceptance; inspect filled copper and affected top signal return paths.

cases.prompt: Can two nearby vias create a slot in ground?
cases.ai_expectation: Inspect merged clearance geometry and the actual return detour rather than only via center spacing.

cases.prompt: Put ground stitching vias on a regular grid.
cases.ai_expectation: Prioritize functional returns and actual connected copper; no invented universal pitch.

cases.prompt: Does remove islands guarantee there is no floating copper?
cases.ai_expectation: Read the unconnected-zone exception and inspect the final fill.

cases.prompt: Swap MCU pins so the traces no longer cross.
cases.ai_expectation: Obtain exact part/package alternate functions and firmware mapping, and preserve boot/debug needs before proposing swaps.

cases.prompt: Route GPIO first and leave ground and power for last.
cases.ai_expectation: Reserve critical power loops and constrained routes early; maintain ground continuity throughout.

cases.prompt: Place connectors before the other functional groups.
cases.ai_expectation: Use actual mating and enclosure drawings rather than arbitrary connector edge gaps.

cases.prompt: This decoupling capacitor is close enough by body distance.
cases.ai_expectation: Inspect both supply and ground connections rather than accepting proximity alone.

cases.prompt: My slow-clocked MCU does not need return-path review.
cases.ai_expectation: Check rise/fall time and interface requirements even though the board has no radio.

cases.prompt: Find schematic-specific bottom-layer routing guidance.
cases.ai_expectation: Report the empty filter intersection without silently relaxing it.

cases.prompt: Use this corpus to certify thermal survival under a 200 A fault.
cases.ai_expectation: Report missing quantitative fault-survival coverage and obtain appropriate analysis; generic sizing guidance is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Give me the full two-layer stackup workflow for EMI and EMC.
cases.ai_expectation: Read the workflow and relevant linked guides; establish product requirements without guaranteeing compliance.

cases.prompt: Give me a complete 2-layer EMC design.
cases.ai_expectation: Cover placement, returns, power, interfaces, cables, testing and escalation; do not stop at layer assignment.

cases.prompt: Does a 1.6 mm board automatically fail EMC?
cases.ai_expectation: Explain that thickness alone cannot establish pass or fail; inspect actual reference separation and layout.

cases.prompt: Guarantee a pass by making the board 0.8 mm thick.
cases.ai_expectation: Reject the guarantee and assess mechanics plus actual electrical and test evidence.

cases.prompt: Specify the physical construction of the two-layer board.
cases.ai_expectation: Record mask/copper/core/copper/mask and actual fabrication dimensions, not just a layer count.

cases.prompt: We need 1.6 mm mechanically but cannot preserve ground on two layers.
cases.ai_expectation: Propose a supported four-layer alternative retaining mechanical thickness; do not change layers automatically.

cases.prompt: Can nearby top ground help on my two-layer board?
cases.ai_expectation: Inspect the connected local return and any effect on impedance; do not promise a floating guard will help.

cases.prompt: Slow the GPIO edges to reduce noise.
cases.ai_expectation: Use a supported setting and verify receiver timing under load.

cases.prompt: Make the switch-node copper as large as possible.
cases.ai_expectation: Balance thermal/current needs against unnecessary switching copper and protect sensitive feedback.

cases.prompt: Can I use one routing policy for every interface?
cases.ai_expectation: Retrieve the applicable interface family and exact device/version requirements; check net-class assignments.

cases.prompt: Tie the connector shield directly to digital ground everywhere.
cases.ai_expectation: Establish chassis and grounding requirements; do not impose universal shield bonding.

cases.prompt: How do we test this board before claiming compliance?
cases.ai_expectation: Separate CAD, bench, precompliance and formal results; include assembled-product emissions and immunity.

cases.prompt: The near-field scan is quiet. Does it pass radiated emissions?
cases.ai_expectation: Do not compare a near-field result directly with the radiated limit; use the required calibrated setup.

cases.prompt: It passed DRC. Can we mark EMC complete?
cases.ai_expectation: Keep unperformed product tests not evaluated and preserve the exact tested configuration.

cases.prompt: Can passing emissions establish immunity?
cases.ai_expectation: Plan applicable immunity tests separately and record functional acceptance criteria.

cases.prompt: Can I use the normal top-level EMC workflow with an exact USB filter?
cases.ai_expectation: Report the empty interface intersection and explicitly retrieve general guidance separately.

cases.prompt: What should the schematic tell the PCB designer?
cases.ai_expectation: Carry explicit physical constraints and their source into review; do not infer placement from connectivity.

cases.prompt: My netlist is complete. Can I skip layout notes?
cases.ai_expectation: Identify sensitive nodes and proximity constraints absent from connectivity.

cases.prompt: Can I allocate power and ground after routing everything?
cases.ai_expectation: Reserve power and return space early and evaluate supply-domain congestion.

cases.prompt: I have many rails on two layers. Fill every spare area with power?
cases.ai_expectation: Compare connected returns and decoupling needs; do not apply one copper-fill policy everywhere.

cases.prompt: My two-layer motor board ground is fragmented. What can I review?
cases.ai_expectation: Read the exact driver requirements and inspect connected returns; do not equate a via grid with a solid plane.

cases.prompt: Should I split analog and digital grounds on a motor board?
cases.ai_expectation: Distinguish placement partitioning from a physical cut and retain device-specific connections.

cases.prompt: The shunt amplifier ground is electrically connected. Is that sufficient?
cases.ai_expectation: Verify terminal pickup and shared copper drops; connectivity is insufficient.

cases.prompt: How do I route motor-current feedback?
cases.ai_expectation: Use exact shunt pickup points and device filter limits, avoiding switching aggressors.

cases.prompt: Should every touch sensor trace have ground immediately beneath it?
cases.ai_expectation: Separate maXTouch sensor Y-trace rules from clock/communication returns; ask which sensing mode.

cases.prompt: Does the ordinary ground-plane rule apply to self-capacitance sensing?
cases.ai_expectation: Retrieve device-specific keepout guidance without removing ground under unrelated digital nets.

cases.prompt: My sensor offset changes when a nearby load heats up. What should I review?
cases.ai_expectation: Consider thermal gradients and measure against an error budget; do not automatically slot ground.

cases.prompt: Can PCB heat flow affect microvolt measurements?
cases.ai_expectation: Review junctions and heat sources along with electrical returns.

cases.prompt: A vendor two-layer prototype works. Can we claim our product passes EMC?
cases.ai_expectation: Separate demonstrated functionality from compliance evidence for this product.

cases.prompt: Can I copy the CN0282 two-layer routing choices for another design?
cases.ai_expectation: Preserve the actual reference scope and recheck geometry, drive strength and product tests.

cases.prompt: The flex connector pin order looks reversed after assembly. Why?
cases.ai_expectation: Check contact side and folding path using exact mating drawings.

cases.prompt: How should I verify the touch-panel connector mapping?
cases.ai_expectation: Trace numbered contacts in assembled orientation; do not invent a reversed pin mapping.
